oracle.source_note: Rewritten for master 2b540fe (the corpus-b-deps dependency-engine era): the README has no dependency section (it points to an external project wiki), so the oracle was compiled by hand from the in-repo dependency manifests. Scope = dependencies that need external artifacts in the default build: require_dep(...) (prebuilt/system mode) and the project's own find_package are runtime/optional; require_source_dep (liblouis/kddockwidgets/picojson/pugixml/utfcpp/googletest/crashpad_client/vst3sdk/lodepng/asiosdk) and mnxdom's FetchContent source mode are vendored, built with the project source and needing no external artifacts, so they are not in the oracle; require_tool/find_package(Git) are host build tools, listed as build. Optionality follows the CorpusBOptions.cmake defaults: CB_MODULE_AUDIO_JACK OFF, CB_MODULE_AUDIO_PIPEWIRE OFF, CB_MODULE_DRAW_USE_QTTEXTDRAW ON (-> msdfgen not enabled), CB_USE_SYSTEM_MNXDOM OFF (-> mnxdom is bundled as source by default; pkg_check only in system mode); CB_MODULE_AUDIO_EXPORT ON, CB_BUILD_IMPEXP_MNX_MODULE ON. The old oracle's (CI setup.sh + CB_COMPILE_USE_SYSTEM_* era) pulseaudio/openssl/tinyxml/ffmpeg no longer exist on master: direct PulseAudio use survives only in the embedded fluidsynth optional driver, and openssl is not referenced by any manifest.

agent_notes: Oracle rewritten for master 2b540fe (corpus-b-deps dependency engine): require_dep manifests (DependencyManifest/ExtDepsManifest) + project find_package (ALSA/Jack/mnxdom) + SetupQt6.cmake; optionality follows CorpusBOptions.cmake defaults. The 10 source-bundled require_source_dep dependencies (liblouis/kddockwidgets/picojson/pugixml/utfcpp/googletest/crashpad_client/vst3sdk/lodepng/asiosdk) are out of oracle scope (built with the project source, no external artifacts needed); portgraph expresses them as vendored edges + fetch-deps status=vendored.

The 10 ALIASES gaps from the previous round (old repo, CI setup.sh era) were fixed and committed in this round (alsa->alsa-lib, sndfile->libsndfile, tinyxml->tinyxml2, glib2->glib, dbus1->dbus, ogg->libogg, vorbis->libvorbis, png->libpng, brotlidec->brotli, utfcpp->utf8cpp, nlohmann_json->nlohmann-json, intl->gettext); false positives from fluidsynth/KDDockWidgets embedded third-party code and corpus-b-deps recipes were fixed by skipping vendored paths; find_package false matches on comment lines were fixed by comment stripping; the wrongful exclusion of the buildscripts/ directory (build* prefix) was fixed.

Residual (not fixed in this round): require_dep conditional blocks are not evaluated (declarations off by default such as msdfgen/pipewire/asiosdk still enter the closure, so the fetch-deps overview is conservative); project-internal target names in the deps report's raw_libs (engraving/global/cb_* etc., created by functions like declare_module and invisible to the add_library scan) resolve to hb:global by coincidence, which is noise.
